title: ShadowDecision
description: Shadow persona decision captured for imitation-learning ground truth. Records what a shadow persona would have decided given the same market context as the human trader. Never routes live orders; feeds Learn loop only.

shadow_persona_id.description: ID of the shadow persona that produced this decision.

reference_operator_id.description: Human trader whose context is being shadowed.

reference_intent_id.description: TradingIntent ID from the human trader being compared against.

market_context_ref.description: Snapshot or ref of the market context at decision time.

rationale.description: Shadow persona's reasoning for this decision.

agreement_with_human.description: Whether shadow decision aligns with the referenced human intent.

divergence_rationale.description: Explanation when the shadow diverges from the human.

evaluation_context.description: Execution context for this shadow run. Never 'live' or 'canary'.

imitation_dataset_eligible.description: Whether this decision may be added to the imitation dataset.

no_order_route_proof.description: Proof claim: shadow decisions never route live orders; they feed Learn loop only.
